fixtures.input: IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY, CRIMINAL WRIT PETITION. The petitioner, a director of M/s Sunrise Agro Pvt Ltd, prays for quashing of FIR No. 118/2024 registered at Pune City police station under Section 420 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code. The complainant advanced Rs. 25,00,000 to the company under a supply agreement dated 04.01.2023 for delivery of soybean meal. Deliveries were partly made; disputes arose regarding quality and set-off. Instead of invoking the arbitration clause, the complainant lodged the FIR alleging cheating. The petitioner submits that the dispute is purely civil in nature, arising from a commercial contract, and the criminal process is being misused as a recovery tactic. It is prayed that this Hon'ble Court quash FIR No. 118/2024 and all consequential proceedings.
